Definition: from G3326 and G718; to lead over, i.e. transfer (direct):--turn about.
BiblicalUsage: James uses this word twice in one breath, for the bit that turns a horse and the rudder that turns a ship. A small thing steers a great body, and James is building his case that the tongue does the same to a life.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that James chose his pictures well: if a bit and a rudder can turn what is far bigger than they are, then the tongue is not a small matter, and neither is the grace that tames it.
